description: we’re relentless rookies, engineering students from jnn college of engineering, shivamogga, building a health monitoring system for astronauts. we love electronics, embedded systems and wearable sensors, with hands-on work on raspberry pi, esp32 and biosignals like heart rate and oxygen levels. join us if you want to build real tech that could save lives in space. we’re looking for people skilled in machine learning, data analysis, app or web development and user interface design.
